$comment: The Railway template, declared. `sh deploy/install.sh railway-template` builds a template draft from it in the Railway workspace you are signed in to (see deploy/railway/README.md). deploy/install.sh carries the same values for its Railway install; test/installScript.test.js fails when the two drift.
name: Cairn
description: Your own self-hosted coach for training, nutrition and longevity.

CAIRN_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Your sign-in token. Open the app URL and sign in with this value, copied from this tab. It is also your recovery key.

CAIRN_SETTINGS_SECRET_KEY.description: Encrypts stored integration passwords. Leave it as generated.

CAIRN_SINGLE_VOLUME.description: Keep sign-ins and AI tools on the one volume at /data.

CAIRN_REQUIRE_AUTH.description: Refuse to start without a token: a Railway URL is public.

CAIRN_BLANK_PROFILE.description: Start with an empty profile, with no demo data.

CAIRN_PLATFORM.description: Tells Cairn how it was deployed.

CAIRN_MAX_AGENT_PROCS.description: Runs one background AI task at a time to keep memory low.

CAIRN_FEEDBACK_URL.description: Where Send feedback delivers (only when you press Send). Set it to off (or an empty value) to turn the feedback service off; feedback then opens a GitHub issue.
